events.title: We're removing generative AI from the game
events.summary: Hey everyone, When we made A Place for Every Potion, we used generative AI for some of the textures and for the music. Many of you asked us to change that, so now we're replacing it. MusicThis part is done. All the music in the full game has been replaced with human-made music. We're also updating the AI disclosure on the store page, so music will no longer be listed there. events.title: New level: One Giant Heap
events.summary: Hey friends, We've added a second level to the game. Where to find itOnce you've put all 4,160 potions on their shelves, the New Game button in the main menu turns into New Game II. Press it and you're back in the same lab, but this time every bottle is waiting in one huge pile in the middle of the room. What's differentIt's harder than the first run. events.title: New skill added: Pour Where It Stands
events.summary: Hi everyone!Until now, if the bottle you wanted to pour into was already standing on a shelf, you had to take it down first.Not anymore. Meet the new skill: Pour Where It Stands. What it doesPour the bottle in your hand straight into a bottle standing in a slot: on a cabinet shelf, on a table, even into a beaker. The bottle stays where it is.
